summary: Dominant magnet override C220103=$1030M cites a source table that publishes $5,100-5,200M and contradicts the concept's own analysis text ($6,916M); uses uncited learning-curve multipliers. At the source value 1GW LCOE would be ~507 vs reported 155.

Both target cost and $/J highly leveraged.
